text: Replaced the parallel LoadError/FmriAcquisition/handle-capability/StudyIndex/selection vocabularies with the existing DatasetError, FmriDataset, DataSelection, DatasetIndex, and DatasetRunPartition algebra. Provenance is now a value in DatasetMetadata. The only hierarchy correction is a checked DatasetRun view over exactly one time-axis block, with zero-copy expansion for multi-run datasets.
